name: Maxwell Yuumi
creator: snorr
description:
**Overview**

\- Replaces Yuumi in all her Skins and Chromas with Maxwell the cat

\- Replaces some sounds effects to different meme-sounds

\- Replaces all Loadscreens and Icons

\- Fully mutes all of Yuumi's voicelines, leaving only meows and purrs

***

**Credits**

\- Model work by Abdomera and Snorr

\- Sounds/Voice and Texture work by Snorr

\- Thank you to mintess. and kanarina for helping me test some skins

***

**Install instructions**

\- Download the file, run it with cslol

\- Enjoy Maxwell a lot

***

If you find issues with the mod you can contact me on Discord: snorr\_
